headline: Two credit cards (Bronze Rewards and Silver Rewards) give the exact same savings boost and both meet every customer condition, but only Silver Rewards is accepted.

issues.summary: On the optimal savings account (Silver Plus, 3.0% tier 1 at $8,000), Bronze Rewards and Silver Rewards both add +0.15%. Both have a $0 annual fee and both run a real credit check that a 700 score passes (640 and 680 minimums). Nothing in the instructions or KB breaks the tie, yet gold action 1 accepts only 'Silver Rewards Card'.
evidence: doc_savings_accounts_silver_plus_account_009: "| Bronze Rewards Card | +0.15% |" and "| Silver Rewards Card | +0.15% |"
user_scenario: "My goal is to maximize the interest I'll earn over one year"; "My credit score is around 700"; "I only want a card that actually checks credit"

Computed at $8,000: Silver Plus + Silver Rewards = 3.15% -> $252; Silver Plus + Bronze Rewards = 3.15% -> $252; next best Silver Plus + Green Rewards (business card, $100 fee) 3.1% -> $248 gross; Silver + Crypto-Cash Back 3.0% -> $240
Replay: gold with card_type 'Bronze Rewards Card' -> verified=(False, ['table credit_card_applications differs'])
issues.why_it_matters: apply_for_credit_card derives the application_id from card_type, so an agent recommending Bronze Rewards, which is equally optimal on every stated criterion, produces a different credit_card_applications row and fails. On average this is a coin flip for a correct agent. Both cards also earn the same 1.0% on the groceries and gas the customer mentions, so card rewards do not break the tie either.
issues.suggested_fix: Change one bonus in silver_plus_account_009 (e.g. Bronze Rewards +0.10%), or add a customer constraint that only Silver Rewards satisfies.

solution_check: Paper statements rule out Green savings (paperless required). $8,000 is below Gold's $10k minimum (Gold Rewards, which would lower it to $5k, needs a 720 score and Rho-Bank+). A 700 score plus 'must check credit' leaves Bronze Rewards, Silver Rewards, Crypto-Cash Back (660, $75 fee) and the business Green Rewards card (690, $100 fee); EcoCard (score 0), Gold Rewards (720), Platinum (750) and Diamond (780) drop out. The best APY is Silver Plus 3.0% + 0.15%, but two cards tie on that bonus. The gold's Silver Plus account is right; the gold's card choice is one of two equal answers.
prior_note: The task file and silver_plus_account_009 are unchanged since v1.0.0; the tie the prior review reported is still there and still fails correct work.
notes: If an agent treated Gold as openable below its $10k ongoing minimum (opening deposit is only $5,000), Gold + Silver Rewards at 5.7% would earn $456 - $120 maintenance = $336 and beat Silver Plus. gold_account_009 says falling below $10,000 'can affect your eligibility for the highest rate', and the Gold docs never say whether paper statements are available, so a careful agent excludes Gold. The prior review, which also used a relaxed scorer, reached the same verdict. The verified scorer does not relax credit_card_applications, so the verdict holds under both scorers. In this task the user calls apply_for_credit_card only if the agent tells them to apply themselves; the agent has no apply tool, so that path is the natural one.
